lazim.text: لَّعَنَهُ ٱللَّهُ ۘ وَقَالَ لَأَتَّخِذَنَّ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ نَصِيبًۭا مَّفْرُوضًۭا
lazim.en: Whom Allah has cursed. For he had said, "I will surely take from among Your servants a specific portion.

lazim.text: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍۢ نُّكُرٍ
lazim.en: So leave them, [O Muhammad]. The Day the Caller calls to something forbidding,

la.text: إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَآ ۙ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
la.en: Except his wife." Allah decreed that she is of those who remain behind.

la.text: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِلَّهِ ٱلْبَنَٰتِ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ ۙ وَلَهُم مَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
la.en: And they attribute to Allah daughters - exalted is He - and for them is what they desire.

jaiz.en: And landmarks. And by the stars they are [also] guided.
The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear Allah?"

mu3anaqah.text: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبُ لَا رَيْبَ ۛ فِيهِ ۛ هُدًۭى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
mu3anaqah.en: This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -

mu3anaqah.text: وَأَنفِقُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا تُلْقُوا۟ بِأَيْدِيكُمْ إِلَى ٱلتَّهْلُكَةِ ۛ وَأَحْسِنُوٓا۟ ۛ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
mu3anaqah.en: And spend in the way of Allah and do not throw [yourselves] with your [own] hands into destruction [by refraining]. And do good; indeed, Allah loves the doers of good.

sakta.en: And it is said, "Who will cure [him]?"
My wealth has not availed me.

sala.en: And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned."
Fruits; and they will be honored

qala.en: And at night. Then will you not use reason?

qala.text: ذُرِّيَّةًۢ بَعْضُهَا مِنۢ بَعْضٍۢ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
qala.en: Descendants, some of them from others. And Allah is Hearing and Knowing.

sajdah.en: So prostrate to Allah and worship [Him].
And they fall upon their faces weeping, and the Qur'an increases them in humble submission.
